content.short: Fjord Foundry is a platform enabling Liquidity Bootstrapping Pools (LBPs) to generate liquidity and distribute tokens with fair price discovery.
content.description: Fjord Foundry provides Liquidity Bootstrapping Pools (LBPs) to generate liquidity and distribute digital tokens with a fair, open, and transparent price discovery mechanism that avoids the negative impact of whales and sniper bots. It also serves as a community hub, connecting projects and supporters through LBPs across multiple chains, including BNB Chain, Ethereum, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana, Multichain and OP Mainnet.
content.meta: Fjord Foundry enables LBPs to bootstrap liquidity and token distribution. Discover Fjord Foundry and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
